text:
Tara (Partnerships): FYI Sierra Integrations wants a packaged asset drop for their SI onboarding: co-branded solution brief, 2 sticker sizes (laptop + parcel seal), webinar slide title slide with lockup, and a short one-paragraph case study blurb. Need legal and design checks before we hand to their enablement team.
Jon (Design): Uploaded initial artboard: https://drive.redwood/sierra/creative_v1.pdf. Notes: recommend horizontal lockup for the slide title, laptop sticker 65x22mm, seal 36mm circle. Will add dielines after legal confirms spacing.
Tara (Partnerships): @Rina can Sierra place their SI partner badge next to ours on the solution brief and slide? Also any mandatory trademark/footer language?
Rina (Legal): They may include their partner mark but not modify our mark or imply co-ownership. Required footer: "Redwood Inference and the Redwood logo are trademarks of Redwood Labs, Inc. Used under license." Add a short clause on case blurb: "Customer names used with permission." Also no "built by" language unless pre-approved. Send final mock for sign-off.
Leo (Marketing): For the marketplace/web listing we need hero 1200x628 + square 800x800. Alt copy suggestion: "Sierra rack with Redwood badge, inference at the edge". Also for webinar title slide headline: "Accelerating LLM Deployment with Sierra + Redwood".
Vik (SI PM): Sierra wants the phrase "SI-certified for Redwood" in partner materials. Legal ok? They also want a short joint waypoint: webinar scheduled in 3 weeks. We need final assets to prep slides.
Rina (Legal): "SI-certified for Redwood" ok if we include: "Certification indicates compatibility and not endorsement." Add that to the brief.
Jon (Design): Quick question: Sierra requests equal-weight logos on the slide. I can do side-by-side, but recommend Redwood slightly dominant for consistency. Mocking both and will post PDFs.
AssetBot: Attached: sierra-brand-guidelines-2026.pdf, sierra-partner-badge.ai
Tara (Partnerships): Timeline: 1) Jon -> print/web PDFs + webinar slide master by Tue noon PT; 2) Rina -> legal sign-off on final mock by Tue 5pm PT; 3) Leo -> final case blurb + alt text by Tue EOD; 4) Vik -> confirm webinar date and SI enablement slot. If anyone can't hit this, flag now.
Jon (Design): Will upload v2 with both lockup options by Tue 11am PT.
Rina (Legal): I'll review v2 by Tue 4pm PT.
Leo (Marketing): I'll tighten the case blurb and provide alt text variants by Tue EOD.
Vik (SI PM): Webinar date tentative: 3 weeks from today. Holding calendar. Will update when confirmed.
Tara (Partnerships): Thanks folks. Once legal signs off I'll package assets and hand to Sierra enablement. :package: Closing thread after final sign-off.
